latestVersion.changelog:
- Improved security: the download script now only accepts image URLs from trusted EdrawMax OSS domains (e.g., .aliyuncs.com, .wondershare.com, .edrawsoft.com, .edrawmax.com) with verified TLS certificates.
- Updated instructions to clarify that user-supplied or third-party URLs are rejected by the download script.
- Added preferred result presentation: render the local PNG as a thumbnail (when supported), present SVG as a clickable high-res link, and display source code in a code block.
- Provided an example output format for user-facing results.
- No functional or API changes; only documentation and usage guidance were updated.
